## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the roadmap ticket when applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and relevant acceptance evidence. Identify unverified scenarios explicitly.

## Documentation impact

Link updated canonical pages, ADRs and the delivery register, or explain why the documented behavior and contracts are unchanged.

## Rollout

For schema or contract changes, describe compatibility, migration/backfill evidence and recovery. Otherwise state that no migration is required.
